senses.gloss: (b. h.; denom. of שָׁלשׁ)to do or come for the third time.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:9">Num. R. s. 4<sup>20</sup></cite> <he>לא יצאת אותה שנה ולא שינתה ולא שִׁילְּשָׁה וכ׳</he> not that year passed, nor the second, nor the third, when &c., i.e. within three years these things occurred; a. e.

senses.gloss: to go back to the third generation.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:7">B. Bath. X, 7</cite> <he>יְשַׁלְּשׁוּ</he> they should write the grandfather’s name in the document.

senses.gloss: to divide into three parts. Ib. III, 4 מְשַׁלְּשִׁין ביניהם the fine is divided between them (the three sets of witnesses convicted of an alibi); Macc. I, 3.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 1:3">Ib.</cite> <he>משלשין בממון ואין מש׳ במכות</he> the monetary fine is divided, but not the punishment (but every one has to undergo the full punishment).
Ab. Zar. 19ᵇ לעולם יְשַׁלִּשׁ אדם שנותיו שליש וכ׳ a man should always divide his years (his time) into three parts, devoting one third to Bible, one to Mishnah &c.; Kidd. 30ᵃ יַשְׁלִישׁ (Hif.).
Ex. R. s. 1527 הריני מְשַׁלְּשָׁם I will divide them among us three; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּלָּשׁ; f. מְשׁוּלֶּשֶׁת; pl. מְשׁוּלָּשִׁים, מְשׁוּלָּשִׁין; מְשׁוּלָּשׁוֹת

senses.gloss: done for the third time. Ab. Zar. l. c., כתוב … ומש׳ בכתובים stated in the Torah, a second time in the Prophets, and a third time in Hagiographa; Meg. 31ᵃ; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: divided into three, arranged in three classes, threefold.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:30">Deut. R. s. 2<sup>33</sup></cite> (ref. to <he>והשלשית</he>, <cite ref="Zechariah 13:8">Zech. XIII, 8</cite>) <he>אלו ישראל אנקראו שלישין שהם מש׳ וכ׳</he> that means Israel, who are called ‘thirds’, for they are divided into three classes, priests &c.

<cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 22:5">Midr. Prov. to XXII, 20</cite> (ref. to <he>שלשים</he>, <cite ref="Midrash Mishlei 22:5">ib.</cite>) <he>כל מעשי תורה מש׳ היא מש׳ ואותיותיה מש׳ … שבט מש׳ וכ׳</he> all affairs of the Torah are threefold; itself is threefold: Torah, Prophets, and Hagiographa, and its signs are threefold: <cite ref="A02072"><he>אמת</he></cite> (Truth); and it was given through a tribe third in order: Reuben, Shimeon, and Levi; <he>משה מש׳</he> Moses the third born &c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:10">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>כל מעשיו … מש׳ היו</he> all the events of that man’s (Solomon’s) life were marked by three stages (rise, fall, and rise).—
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:7">B. Bath. X, 7</cite> <he>ואם היו מש׳</he> and if the names are alike up to the grandfather (v. supra); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 1:5:5">Y. Shebi. I, 33ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02831"><he>מְשׁוּלָּשׁ</he></cite>.—
senses.label: b

senses.gloss: developed to one third of the full growth, v. מְשׁוּלָּשׁ.
senses.label: c

senses.gloss: (apocop. of שִׁלְשֵׁל) to let down, v. שִׁלְשֵׁל I.
to divide into three parts. Kidd. l. c., v. supra.
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 42a:3">B. Mets. 42ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם יַשְׁלִישׁ … שליש וכ׳</he> a man should always have his capital divided into three parts, one-third invested in land, one in merchandise, and one in ready money; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 897:12">Yalk. Deut. 897</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 6:7">Keth. VI, 7</cite> <he>המַשְׁלִישׁ מעות לבתו … מה שׁהוּשְׁלַשׁ בידו</he> if a father deposits money for the benefit of his daughter, and she says, I trust my husband (and want it to be given to him), the trustee must do that with it for which it was deposited with him; <cite ref="Ketubot 69b:5-6">ib. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>המשליש … לחתנו וכ׳</he> if one deposits money with his son-in-law to buy with it &c.; <cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 6:9">Tosef. ib. VI, 9</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: to have been at a thing for the third time.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:48">Num. R. s. 9</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00556"><he>מוּעָד</he></cite>.
